ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering the majority of the fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters concentrated at the distal lateral tips and along thin linear abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (dark) mapping across the central and proximal lobe regions. Distinct, high-contrast white clusters localized at the far-left and far-right distal margins. Scattered, thin high-intensity linear streaks across the mid-lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped central depression with a moderate depth-to-width ratio dividing the two fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, variable-amplitude jagged serrations and small notches across the entire continuous linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve extending from the peduncle attachment point to the outer lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) located at the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) of varying lengths; approximately 3-4 prominent diagonal marks on the left lobe and 2-3 shorter horizontal/diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jaggedness and irregular loss of edge tissue along the trailing margin; heavy white barnacle encrustation at the lateral extremes.
